scope: Selected milestones, not an exhaustive release history. No events after the verification date are asserted.

sources.title: Introducing ChatGPT
sources.supports: ChatGPT research preview launch; fine-tuned from the GPT-3.5 series; free during the research preview.

sources.title: GPT-4
sources.supports: GPT-4 is an image-and-text input multimodal model. OpenAI reported a simulated bar-exam score around the top 10%. At launch ChatGPT received text input; image capability was not generally available.

sources.title: New models and developer products announced at DevDay
sources.supports: GPT-4 Turbo with a 128K-token context window. The film explicitly labels this as an API context window.

sources.title: Introducing GPTs
sources.supports: Custom versions of ChatGPT called GPTs. The film describes this historical launch, not present-day availability.

sources.title: Hello GPT-4o
sources.supports: GPT-4o announcement; native text, audio and visual processing; average audio response time of 320 ms in the model capability description. Not a claim that every ChatGPT interaction achieves that latency, or that all voice features shipped on that date.

sources.title: Introducing OpenAI o1-preview
sources.supports: Reasoning-model series designed to spend more time thinking before answering; first preview in ChatGPT and API. No later-model benchmark scores are attributed to o1-preview.

sources.title: Introducing 4o Image Generation
sources.supports: Native image generation built into GPT-4o. All artwork in the film is original procedural geometry, explicitly not model-output samples.

sources.title: Introducing OpenAI o3 and o4-mini
sources.supports: Reasoning models can combine ChatGPT tools, including web search, Python data analysis, visual reasoning and image generation.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5
sources.supports: GPT-5 launch; unified system routes between fast responses and deeper reasoning. Film does not claim that routing remains the same in later releases.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
sources.supports: Computer-use and professional multistep task capabilities. Launch date and initially limited organizational rollout cross-checked against source 13. No benchmark or AGI claims are made.

sources.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
sources.supports: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI introduction. Visual and interactive responses. The opening says more than 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week. This is a dated official disclosure, not an independent audience audit or an anniversary-date estimate.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.supports: Visual reasoning, computer use and writing; introduced in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Date cross-checked against source 13.

sources.title: ChatGPT release notes
sources.supports: Dated entries for GPT-6 Astra on September 3, GPT-6 / Intelligent UI on October 7, and GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, 2026.

visualReferences.observed: Large neutral sans-serif typography; generous white space; black and white structure; rounded prompt and pill controls. Observed in browser on 2026-11-11.
Black cinematic hero, luminous particle field forming a six, simple GPT / Astra typography. Used as a reference for scale, light and material contrast; the original figure-six artwork is not reused.

visualReferences.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra: the most intelligent and aligned model in the world.
visualReferences.observed: Official verified OpenAI channel. Watched/sampled the opening, around 00:56, 02:07 and 02:35. Warm everyday spaces, practical screens as the focus of action, cuts between intent and output, oversized simple word reveal near the end. Reference only; no footage or audio copied.
